title: 自動販賣機投幣
question:
你身上有一些 50 元、10 元、5 元硬幣，要剛好投 x 元買飲料。請輸入 50 元、10 元、5 元各有幾枚，再輸入 x，輸出有幾種投法。
想想看：其實知道 50 元和 10 元各投幾枚之後，5 元要幾枚就能算出來，可以少一層迴圈嗎？

en.title: Vending Machine Coins
en.question:
You have some 50, 10, and 5 dollar coins. You need to pay exactly x dollars. Input how many 50s, 10s, and 5s you have, then x. Output how many ways you can pay.
Think: Once you know the 50s and 10s, you can work out the 5s. Can you use one less loop?
